title: Bedrock Caves
description: Bedrock Caves generation inspired by Kenadian
body:
## Bedrock Caves generation inspired by stream series by the same name from [Kenadian](https://www.youtube.com/channel/UClGMwdvf9Ftbh7EeB_t8n-g).

<iframe width="560" height="315" src="https://www.youtube-nocookie.com/embed/dCTuLRD1hJo" title="YouTube video player" frameborder="0" allow="accelerometer; autoplay; clipboard-write; encrypted-media; gyroscope; picture-in-picture; web-share" allowfullscreen></iframe>

Obviously its not the same as the world in the stream is purposely worldedited, while this one attempts to do the same expirience but naturally generated.

Features
- Spawns you underground at anywhere between y=-64 and y=0.
- All deepslate and stone is replaced by bedrock.
- Everything else is left as it is (ores, structures, etc).
- Going over y=70 damages the player similar to the worldborder damage.
- Villagers are disabled.

Warning!
May lag due to constant block replacement (which causes block updates and redraws). Its not really possible to replace them at the generation step due to certain block quirks.

(officially endorsed by kenadian)

![kenadian saying its cool](https://cdn.modrinth.com/data/cached_images/e32853e2eb74fcb71d1ce43d1ef332deb65c04de.png)
